name: ConnieAI
summary: Charter and Go's aviation-focused AI, designed to help automate customer inquiries, gather missing trip information, assist with quoting and speed up the sales process. It sits alongside AI-generated quotes from incoming inquiries, aircraft recommendation models and dynamic pricing in the company's platform for Part 91, 135 and 121 operators and brokers. Charter and Go is demonstrating it at NBAA-BACE, booth 3517 (announced September 29).

whyItMatters: Missing trip details are why a charter request sits in the inbox while a competitor quotes it. If the AI chases passenger count, dates and airports for you, measure how many more requests turn into sent quotes in the first 30 days.
